free_tier.stated: unverified: no first-party page read states a free inference allowance or a sign-up credit for Prime Inference, and the account dashboard behind sign-in was not opened
free_tier.notes: The answer to 'How is inference priced?' on the vendor's inference page states only that the Serverless API, Prime Gateway included, is billed per token and that dedicated capacity is sized and priced with the team. A wallet is funded before requests succeed: the troubleshooting page shows insufficient_funds when the billed account lacks balance.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a token request, not a stored object
per_object_cap.notes: Model context and maximum output are per-model; the API catalog lists them per model ID.

retention.stated: unverified: no first-party page read states how long request content is retained

egress.terms: no published egress allowance or price for inference requests: the pages read state per-token inference prices and prepaid-credit or card payment, but no separate charge for traffic out of the API

interface_detail: OpenAI-compatible chat-completions REST API at https://api.pinference.ai/api/v1, with a GET /models catalog; the Prime CLI selects models and manages deployments with `prime inference`.
tooling: Any OpenAI SDK pointed at the API base URL with a Prime API key; the Prime CLI from uv (`uv tool install prime`, `prime login`) offers the same model list and deployment commands.
chaining: The OpenAI-compatible endpoint drops into an existing chat-completions client; team credits are selected per request with the X-Prime-Team-ID header.

limits.value: requests stop with insufficient_funds when the wallet funding the API key, or the team selected by X-Prime-Team-ID, has no balance; prepaid credits expire 12 months after purchase
unverified: supported parameters and limits are per model and the numeric request-rate values are published only in the account's model catalog, behind sign-in

limits_note: Pricing, limits and supported features are set per model and shown in the catalog, which was read as a paid model list without a numeric request-rate limit.
binding_note: The billed wallet is the constraint that stops a request first: the troubleshooting page states that a request returns insufficient_funds when the account billed for it lacks balance, while no numeric request-rate value is published outside the logged-in catalog.

identity_cost.detail: Account access is documented as `prime login` and an API key generated under Settings -> API Keys; a funded wallet is required for requests, and the terms state that payment is by card or another payment method made available on the platform, with usage drawn down against prepaid credits and automatic top-up optional. The exact fields of the account-creation form (email, password or a sign-in provider) were not visible: unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: A request with an unfunded account returns insufficient_funds; on-demand dedicated endpoints incur GPU-hour charges while serving, including idle time.
confidence_note: The per-token billing shape, the API endpoint, the per-model limits and the insufficient-funds condition come from first-party pages and the vendor's JSON model catalog read on 2026-11-24. No free allowance, retention term or signup form was published in those pages.
